raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "take"
  role subject "upgrading our Jira Data Center from 9.4 to 10.3"
  role object "a full weekend"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "the vendor"

@s2 stated
  relation "include"
  role subject "the upgrade"
  role object "reindexing"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "the vendor"

@s3 stated
  relation "be compatible with"
  role subject "the old Tempo plugin"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted
  speaker "the vendor"

@s4 stated
  relation "triple"
  role subject "support volume"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid during "the last week of November"

@q query
  where any
    match
      relation "do the upgrade"
      role subject "the user"
      role time "before Black Friday"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "do the upgrade"
      role subject "the user"
      role time "January"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
